title: 1. Overview
body: Vertical Form-Fill-Seal Packaging Machine Manual. Rated for continuous packaging-line duty. Follow lockout/tagout before any intrusive maintenance.

title: 2. Safety
body: Isolate energy sources. Wear hearing protection near rotating equipment. Do not bypass interlocks during production.

title: 3. Fault E-102
body: Fault code E-102: Seal jaw temperature deviation. Troubleshooting: Check heater SSR, PID tune, thermocouple. Related spare parts: HJ-220 heater cartridge, TC-K-jaw thermocouple, PTFE-25 seal tape.

title: 3. Fault E-105
body: Fault code E-105: Film tracking offset. Troubleshooting: Inspect dancer rollers and edge sensor. Related spare parts: HJ-220 heater cartridge, TC-K-jaw thermocouple, PTFE-25 seal tape.

title: 3. Fault E-110
body: Fault code E-110: Jaw pressure low. Troubleshooting: Verify pneumatic regulator and jaw bushings. Related spare parts: HJ-220 heater cartridge, TC-K-jaw thermocouple, PTFE-25 seal tape.

title: 4. Preventive maintenance
body: Daily: listen for abnormal noise. Weekly: vibration spot check. Monthly: inspect fasteners, lubrication, and seals.
